text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Do you have a little time later today?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I got an invitation. Something about a
thank-you
gift. Evidently I'm supposed
to bring you along
too.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabeee! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-welcome to the special public
performance by
the Opera O Troupe!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Thanks for coming, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thanks to your help with my
research the
other day, we were able to
complete our opera!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
After talking to the kids, we decided to
do a
performance for you to enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Fine. Not sure this is really my scene
though...

text_block_list.name: Cheeky-Faced Boy
text_block_list.text:
What do you even have to worry about?!
During
the show, I laughed so hard, my
stomach's all
muscly now!

text_block_list.name: Smart-Looking Boy
text_block_list.text:
It's a spectacle mixing the telling of
legends with
participatory elements!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Girl
text_block_list.text:
The T.M. Opera Beauty Beam was so
sparkly! You
have to see it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Brave warrior and dear friend! How many
years
have you been in search of the
legendary blade?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At last, you have returned to your
Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: La laa! ♪ I have returned. ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Speak of your good health and tales of
your
journey!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was saved by the spirits of the shining
stars. And
I crossed the perilous bridge
before the waiting
giant. ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The hanging bridge of the ferocious
giant! ♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was led across the bubbling poison
swamp by
those spirits of the shining
stars. ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It wasn't anything like that...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, kind spirits of the stars! Here
lies the
helmet and blade!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Light up the world! Shine brightly! T.M.
OPERA
BEAUTY BEAAAM!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! BEAAAM!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's so bright! Is that even natural?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Okay, everyone! How was it?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: It was so much fuuun!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Well, it was different from what I
expected.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, I'm glad to hear that! So,
Ayabe...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto tells me that today's performance
wouldn't
have been possible without
your help!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Here! Take this as a token of my
appreciation!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Should we get out of here?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised you can get something so
dramatic
with just two actors.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It wasn't bad, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You know... Before, I always felt that
receiving
stuff like this was a burden.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
But sometimes words aren't enough, I
guess.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I didn't feel like I was taking on a burden

accepting their thanks, even if that
"thanks" was a
super flashy, super noisy
play.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're kidding, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I've had enough of searching for
legendary items.
For now at least...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega appears exasperated, but I
can tell
she's not entirely bothered by
what's taken place.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
How about your office? They'll look nice
in there.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I won't hear the end of it if Curren sees
them in
our dorm room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she talks, she appears more relaxed
than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm just talking about manners of
courtesy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's nothing to get all emotional about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's detached facade is the
same as
always, but I think beneath it
something in her
has changed.
